added_lines: we remember and pray for jimmy reynolds who was laid to rest in our parish this weekend and we also pray for noelle williams (nee rogers) sister of terry, late of berkshire and grattan ave. may they rest in peace in the home of jesus. amen. congratulations. aoife barry and joseph gilbride who were married in our church this weekend. wishing them a lifetime of happiness together. saturday 31st october 7.00 p.m : timmy mcmanus. sunday 1st november 9.00 a.m : pro populo sunday 1st november . all the deceased of our parish. ceremony of remembrance on sunday 29th november 5 p.m. eternal rest grant unto them o lord. may they rest in peace. amen drumshanbo
